How we handle eBilling and A/R

We are building eBilling and accounts receivable into a dedicated service. Our growth plan consolidates this work in Phase 3, using acquired billing specialists and four AI finance agents priced on days-to-pay (Frontline growth plan). We can't yet quote turnaround times or fees for your firm. Those depend on a baseline from your own billing data.

  • Client-side AI now reviews more law-firm invoices.

  • Consolidation: We will bring eBilling and A/R work together in one service in Phase 3.
  • Specialist teams: We plan to add billing expertise through acquisitions. The screen includes Helm360, The Garver Group and The Legal Billing Group. These are candidates under review, not completed deals (Frontline growth plan).
  • AI finance agents: Four finance agents will run parts of the workflow.
  • Pricing: Fees will be priced on days-to-pay, so our pricing tracks how quickly you collect.
  • International: Phase 4 extends the service to the UK and Canada through local providers. That screen includes Accurate Legal Billing.

markdown:
# How we handle eBilling and A/R

We are building eBilling and accounts receivable into a dedicated service. Our growth plan consolidates this work in Phase 3, using acquired billing specialists and four AI finance agents priced on days-to-pay (Frontline growth plan). We can't yet quote turnaround times or fees for your firm. Those depend on a baseline from your own billing data.

## Why billing needs attention

- Client-side AI now reviews more law-firm invoices.
- Invoice rejections have risen from 11% to 18% (Frontline growth plan).
- More rejections mean more rework before a firm gets paid. That is the problem this service is built to address.

## How the plan works

- **Consolidation:** We will bring eBilling and A/R work together in one service in Phase 3.
- **Specialist teams:** We plan to add billing expertise through acquisitions. The screen includes Helm360, The Garver Group and The Legal Billing Group. These are candidates under review, not completed deals (Frontline growth plan).
- **AI finance agents:** Four finance agents will run parts of the workflow.
- **Pricing:** Fees will be priced on days-to-pay, so our pricing tracks how quickly you collect.
- **International:** Phase 4 extends the service to the UK and Canada through local providers. That screen includes Accurate Legal Billing.

## Timing

| Phase | Plan months | Billing role | Calendar (est.) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | 12-30 | eBilling and A/R consolidation | Oct 2027 to Apr 2029 |
| 4 | 24-42 | UK and Canada, incl. billing providers | Oct 2028 to Apr 2030 |

The calendar dates are estimates. They count from the Oct 2026 starting point in the KPI roadmap (Frontline growth plan).

## What we can't tell you yet

The plan does not specify these details:

- The tasks each of the four agents will handle.
- Fee levels.
- Current days-to-pay results.

Three data points would let us answer for your firm:

- Your invoice rejection rate.
- Your average days-to-pay.
- Your billing volume by client or eBilling portal.

Billing is where Frontline touches a firm's cash. The business was bought at roughly 12-15x on about $16-20M of EBITDA (est.) with a $90M term loan (Frontline public filings), so a days-to-pay service is one of the levers that has to carry EBITDA growth.

## Next actions for the operating team

1. Set a baseline for rejection rate and days-to-pay with three to five pilot clients before Phase 3 starts.
2. Define the scope of each of the four finance agents and how days-to-pay pricing will be measured and verified.
3. Move the eBilling screen (Helm360, The Garver Group, The Legal Billing Group) into first-round diligence. Size each target's revenue against the roughly $25M of acquired revenue assumed by month 24 (est., KPI roadmap).
4. Hold customer-facing copy to plan language until the first billing acquisition closes.
